title: The Vanishing Watch
scene: At 2:20 PM, the clockmaker's gold watch disappeared. Blinds were down for the street fair from 2:00 to 2:40.

suspects.name: Hana Vale
suspects.testimony: I was repairing a mantel clock at 2:20 by the window.
suspects.alibiProof: The bench lamp log shows Hana's light at 2:18.

suspects.name: Felix Ash
suspects.testimony: I was sweeping the front step at 2:20.
suspects.alibiProof: The doorbell camera shows Felix outside at 2:19.

suspects.name: Greta Lund
suspects.testimony: I was browsing the display at 2:20.
suspects.alibiProof: The display camera shows Greta at 2:16 and 2:24.

suspects.name: Silas Wren
suspects.testimony: I was in the back room at 2:20, waiting for the blinds to rise.
suspects.contradiction: The back room was locked from outside, and watch links were in Silas's pocket.
